protocol.continuation: original task Goal, native N=2 argmax at every query after the first
protocol.stopping: unchanged native stop immediately on environment success or done; otherwise 300 actions
protocol.execution_order: task ascending, init ascending, original Clean selected candidate then the other candidate
protocol.seed_rule: native run_episode resets seed31 independently for every fresh branch; order never enters seeds

resource_gate.secondary: failure-penalized completion cost: successful steps, otherwise 300; cannot rescue primary gate
resource_gate.incomplete: No verdict until all60 valid and all30 original-selected trajectories pass exact parity
resource_gate.uncertainty: Exploratory task-cluster summaries; 10 tasks, not 30 independent tasks
resource_gate.stop_rule: If the fixed gate fails, do not select another query, continuation or horizon to search for a positive result

execution.on_any_error: terminal; no replacement, retry or remaining branches
execution.scientific_protocol: Original candidate order, original Goal, seed31/32, N2 continuation, 300-step budget and exact checks unchanged
